title: The Broad Street pump and the birth of epidemiology
researchPrompt: Explain how John Snow established that cholera spread through water rather than air, and why the reasoning mattered more than the conclusion.
suggestedAngles: Follow the evidence: the map, the outlier cases, and what they ruled out
Frame it as the invention of a method rather than the solving of one outbreak
Use the resistance he met to show how theory change actually happens

title: What the printing press actually changed
researchPrompt: Explain the second-order consequences of movable type in Europe, beyond the obvious point that books got cheaper.
suggestedAngles: Trace standardisation: fixed spelling, page numbers, and the idea of an edition
Follow the collapse in the cost of coordinating a dispersed movement
Argue the counterfactual: which changes needed print and which were already underway

title: Why the fall of Rome is still argued about
researchPrompt: Explain why historians disagree about the fall of the Western Roman Empire, and what the disagreement reveals about historical explanation itself.
suggestedAngles: Contrast catastrophe with transformation as competing framings of the same evidence
Show how the question smuggles in an assumption that there was a single event to explain
Use the multiplicity of proposed causes to argue about overdetermination
